description: The file defines the EnumDefWrapper class which extends Wrapper and implements TemplateMappings. It encapsulates an EnumDefinition object and provides methods to access it, as well as creating EnumVariable instances.

classes.name: EnumDefWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for EnumDefinition that implements TemplateMappings and provides access to enum-related data.

methods.name: EnumDefWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with an EnumDefinition object.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Creates and returns an EnumVariable based on the encapsulated EnumDefinition.
